description: This file defines utility functions for error handling, including extracting error codes, reading error names, collecting error graph candidates, type guarding for NodeJS error objects, checking specific errno codes, and formatting error messages with redaction.

methods.name: extractErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts a string error code from an unknown error object.

methods.name: readErrorName
methods.description: Reads the name property from an error object.

methods.name: collectErrorGraphCandidates
methods.description: Collects related error objects in a graph starting from a given error, resolving nested errors via a provided function.

methods.name: isErrno
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a NodeJS.ErrnoException.

methods.name: hasErrnoCode
methods.description: Checks if an error has a specific errno code.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats an error into a string message, including nested causes, with redaction.

methods.name: formatUncaughtError
methods.description: Formats an uncaught error, handling specific error codes and redacting sensitive information.
